root_cause.text: The nouveau GSP driver used WARN_ON macros to validate ACPI return types and buffer lengths, causing unnecessary kernel warnings (and potential panic if panic_on_warn is set) for expected or harmless ACPI failures.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces WARN_ON with simple if conditions in three ACPI probe functions (r535_gsp_acpi_caps, r535_gsp_acpi_jt, r535_gsp_acpi_dod). The commit message states: "These WARN_ONs seem to trigger a lot, and we don't seem to have a plan to fix them, so just drop them, as they are most likely harmless." The Fixes tag references commit 176fdcbddfd2 which introduced the WARN_ONs.
